findings.claim: Q3 2026 銷售約9.53億美元(+10%)；Aerospace & Industrial 2.82億(+14%)、Defense Electronics 2.59億(+2%，商用航空OEM航電出貨時點偏低)、Naval & Power 4.12億(+12%)；全年銷售成長指引上調至8-10%
Q3 簡報：海軍國防銷售成長指引上調至9-11%(2月為5-7%、5月為6-8%)，因潛艦與航母計畫加速及航母大修售後；商用核能受國際售後、SMR、政府核能帶動；AP1000訂單未納入指引
findings.excerpt: Accelerated global defense spending driving overall strong A&D market growth Power & Process 13 - 15% 13 - 15% 19% ▪ Commercial Nuclear growth driven by aftermarket demand (esp. international markets), next-generation advanced reactors (SMRs) and increased govt. nuclear; AP1000 order excluded from targets ▪ Growth in Process driven by increased sales of valves (MRO and large capital projects)
